title: Time Capsule
summary: River takes you to a pullout with one tree on the Badlands west road to bury a tin with something you will miss.
description: River wants to bury a rusted ammo tin at a pullout on the Badlands west road, under the one tree there. He asks V to bring something they will miss.

start.bringUp: River wants to bury a tin at a pullout on the Badlands west road and asks V to bring something they will miss.

variations.know: The last tin is still in the red dirt by the tree, and the spade is stuck upright beside it.
variations.wants: The old note read out loud.

variations.know: River has brought an extra tin, and he wants to bury something for Randy this time.
variations.wants: Something for Randy, and a reason.

variations.know: The pullout is quiet, and V has brought a promise instead of an object.
variations.wants: V's promise to be buried honestly.

pullout.name: the pullout on the Badlands west road with one tree

RWH4.inv.text: Badlands west road, a pullout with one tree. Bring something you won't miss and something you will.

g1.asks: What are you putting in, and who is it for?
g1.know: You are at the pullout with the tin and the spade. The tree is the only thing standing near the red dirt.
g1.secret: His own note is a single line.
g1.wants: V to name who it is for.

stages.label: River and V bury the tin under the tree
stages.objective: Bury the tin with River under the tree
stages.know: You are at the pullout on the Badlands west road with one tree. River has a rusted ammo tin and a spade, and V has brought the item and the note.
stages.wants: V to bury the tin and say who it is for.

for-someone.memory: You buried a tin with a note at the pullout on the Badlands west road, and you named who it was for.

buried.memory: You buried a tin at the pullout on the Badlands west road, and the note stayed private.
